questions.prompt: Name a real mountain, mountain peak or volcano.
questions.review: Single mountains and peaks only; MTS ranges already have their own admitted inventory. Review PKS groups rather than importing blindly.
questions.scope: Named mountains, mountain peaks and volcanoes on Earth count. Whole mountain ranges, unnamed coordinates, fictional mountains and names only found on other planets are outside this inventory.

questions.prompt: Name a real island or archipelago.
questions.review: Country and island/archipelago may share a real name. Standard continent-versus-island boundary must be stated clearly; no country slicing creates extra prompts.
questions.scope: Real named islands and archipelagos worldwide count, including islands that share a country name. Continental mainlands are not treated as islands. Fictional islands do not count.
